name: Custom Shape Magnetic Car Visor Photo Clip With Acrylic Pieces
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic and stainless steel, offering a durable, lightweight, and functional keepsake design.
    - Built with a layered acrylic structure that securely holds your photo in place while creating a personalized decorative frame.
    - Includes a stainless steel visor clip for firm attachment to the car sun visor.
    - Uses strong disc magnets at the acrylic corners to keep the frame closed securely.
    - Each acrylic sheet is made with 3mm thickness, providing a sturdy and clear display surface.
    - The added acrylic pieces increase the decorative appeal and make the product feel more lively and cheerful, supports up to 4 pieces per design.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in the following size options:
              +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
              +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
    - Acrylic piece size:
              +) Maximum piece size: 5 cm
              +) Minimum piece size: 2 cm
    - Disc magnets: 5mm x 3mm, supports up to 8 pairs of magnets.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Layer 1 (Back Acrylic Panel): 1-sided printing or no printing
    - Layer 2 (Front Acrylic Frame): 1-sided printing
    - Acrylic Pieces
              +) Layer 1: No printing
              +) Layer 2: 1-sided printing
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a car visor photo clip and a personalized decorative keepsake.
    - Designed to hold a favorite photo securely between two magnetic acrylic sheets.
    - The stainless steel visor clip attaches firmly to most car sun visors for convenient display while driving.
    - Strong corner magnets help keep the acrylic sheets aligned and closed.
    - Suitable for displaying family photos, memorial photos, couple photos, pet photos, or themed keepsake designs in the car.
    - Perfect for adding a sentimental and personalized touch to your vehicle interior.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for parents, spouses, partners, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, memorial gifts, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who wants to keep a cherished photo close while traveling.
    - A thoughtful gift for drivers, commuters, and loved ones who enjoy sentimental car accessories.
    - Great for family keepsakes, remembrance gifts, and personalized vehicle décor.
    - Adds a warm, personal, and memorable touch to every drive🎁

 

  • Installation Guide:
    - Step 1: Gently pull apart the two acrylic sheets. They are held together by 4 corner magnets.
    - Step 2: Insert the photo between the two acrylic sheets.
    - Step 3: Align the sheets and let the magnets snap them back together.
    - Step 4: Peel off the protective layer on the double-sided tape attached to the clip.
    - Step 5: Stick the clip to the center back of the acrylic frame and press firmly.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Magnetic Car Visor Photo Clip With Acrylic Pieces

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
